title: Set Z-Axis Home Position (Tipper Commissioning)
summary: On the OptiSweep tipper HMI, use the "Visu_MDs" (F2) screen to enter the previously recorded Z-axis "Home Offset" values into the "New Value" column for each Z-axis, press UPDATE to apply, and repeat for the other Z-axis.
when_to_use: Use during tipper commissioning when you need to set each tipper Z-axis "Home Offset" to the previously recorded value and confirm the update on the "Visu_MDs" screen.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the HMI parameter update on the "Visu_MDs" (F2) screen by entering the recorded "Home Offset" values and confirming with UPDATE.

access_required: OptiSweep HMI access sufficient to change settings on the "Visu_MDs" (F2) screen

visual_references.description: Manual image context for the tipper commissioning step "SET Z-AXIS HOME POSITION" showing navigation to "Visu_MDs" (F2) and the Z-axis motor positioning check context.

steps.title: Navigate to the "Visu_MDs" (F2) screen
steps.purpose: Open the HMI screen where the Z-axis "Home Offset" values are entered and updated.
steps.instruction: On the OptiSweep HMI, navigate to the "Visu_MDs" screen using the F2 function key.
steps.expected_result: The "Visu_MDs" screen is displayed and ready for editing the Z-axis "Home Offset" settings.
steps.healthy_condition: The "Visu_MDs" screen is active (F2) and shows the "Home Offset" setting(s) with an editable "New Value" column.
steps.failure_condition: The "Visu_MDs" screen does not open, or the "Home Offset" "New Value" fields are not available for editing.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.23.8: SET Z-AXIS HOME POSITION 1. Navigate to the "Visu_MDs" screen (F2).

steps.title: Enter recorded Z-axis "Home Offset" values into "New Value"
steps.purpose: Apply the previously recorded "Home Offset" values to each Z-axis via the "New Value" column.
steps.instruction: For each Z-axis, locate the "Home Offset" setting and enter the previously recorded value into the "New Value" column.
steps.expected_result: Each Z-axis "Home Offset" field shows the entered value in the "New Value" column.
steps.healthy_condition: All intended Z-axis "Home Offset" entries are present in the "New Value" column (one per Z-axis) and match the previously recorded values.
steps.failure_condition: A "Home Offset" value cannot be entered, or the entered "New Value" does not match the previously recorded value for that Z-axis.

actions.label: Set Home Offset New Value
actions.exact_action: For each Z-axis, for the "Home Offset" setting, enter the value recorded in the previous procedure in the "New Value" column.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.23.8: SET Z-AXIS HOME POSITION 2. For each Z-axis, for the "Home Offset" setting, enter the value recorded in the previous procedure in the "New Value" column.

steps.title: Press UPDATE to confirm the change
steps.purpose: Apply the entered "Home Offset" "New Value" to the system.
steps.instruction: Press UPDATE to confirm the change for the Z-axis.
steps.expected_result: After pressing UPDATE, the "Home Offset" setting reflects the entered "New Value" for that Z-axis.
steps.healthy_condition: The "Home Offset" value shown on the "Visu_MDs" screen updates to the newly entered value after UPDATE.
steps.failure_condition: Pressing UPDATE does not apply the entered "New Value" (the "Home Offset" value does not change as expected).

actions.label: Confirm update
actions.exact_action: Press UPDATE to confirm the change.

stop_or_escalate_if: If UPDATE does not apply the entered "New Value" (values do not change as expected), stop and escalate for support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.23.8: SET Z-AXIS HOME POSITION 3. Press UPDATE to confirm the change.

steps.title: Repeat for the other Z-axis
steps.purpose: Ensure all Z-axis "Home Offset" settings are updated to their recorded values.
steps.instruction: Repeat the "Home Offset" "New Value" entry and UPDATE confirmation for the other Z-axis.
steps.expected_result: The other Z-axis "Home Offset" reflects its entered "New Value" after pressing UPDATE.
steps.healthy_condition: Both Z-axis "Home Offset" values on the "Visu_MDs" screen match the previously recorded values after their respective UPDATE actions.
steps.failure_condition: The other Z-axis does not update after UPDATE, or its "Home Offset" does not match the previously recorded value.
stop_or_escalate_if: If UPDATE does not apply the entered "New Value" for the other Z-axis (values do not change as expected), stop and escalate for support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.23.8: SET Z-AXIS HOME POSITION 4. Repeat for the other Z-axis.

success_criteria: After pressing UPDATE for each Z-axis, the "Home Offset" setting(s) on the "Visu_MDs" screen reflect the entered "New Value" values.
healthy_conditions: On the "Visu_MDs" (F2) screen, each Z-axis "Home Offset" value matches the previously recorded value after its UPDATE confirmation.
failure_conditions: Pressing UPDATE does not change the "Home Offset" value to match the entered "New Value" for a Z-axis.
escalation_guidance: If UPDATE does not apply the entered "New Value" (values do not change as expected), stop and escalate for support.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: 7.3.23.8: Navigate to "Visu_MDs" (F2); enter recorded "Home Offset" values into "New Value"; press UPDATE; repeat for the other Z-axis.

missing_details: The packet does not specify the exact on-screen confirmation behavior after pressing UPDATE (e.g., whether a pop-up appears or which field changes). Use the observable change in the "Home Offset" value on the "Visu_MDs" screen as the confirmation.
